Privacy, clearly.

This policy covers the Room website and the planned Mac App Store edition, developed by Konstantin Merenkov. The Store edition is in preparation and is not yet available.

Last updated 21 October 2026.

The websiteFiles and accessLocal suggestionsLocal recordsSupportChangesContact

The website.

This website uses no analytics or advertising SDKs, tracking cookies, or contact forms. It does not ask you to create an account. Its interactive illustrations run in your browser without sending your selections to the developer.

The service hosting the website receives normal web requests. Those requests may include an IP address, browser information, requested page, time and diagnostic information used to deliver and protect the service. Hosting infrastructure may keep operational or security logs. This policy does not claim that visiting a website involves no network processing.

Links to the Mac App Store, when available, open an Apple service governed by Apple’s privacy information. Contact links open your mail application rather than submitting a form to this website.

Files and access.

The planned Store app inspects file names, paths, file types, logical and allocated sizes, dates and filesystem identities in folders that you approve or that macOS otherwise permits it to access. This metadata supports Disk Map, category views and supported cache review.

Approved read-only folder bookmarks are intended to remain on your Mac. Changes require the relevant write access and review. macOS controls system permissions; Room cannot grant itself Full Disk Access. Inaccessible or limited measurements must remain identified as partial or held.

The Store edition is intended to keep scan reports and recovery information local. The final signed release must be checked against this policy before it is submitted. Large or hidden files are not treated as unnecessary simply because of their size or location.

Local suggestions.

Optional on-device Foundation Models analysis is planned to receive a bounded selection of file names, relative paths, types, sizes and timestamps. Scanned file contents are excluded from that analysis. Apple Intelligence availability is controlled by your Mac and its system settings; rule-based review remains available otherwise.

The initial Store scope excludes the direct edition’s external LM Studio runtime and its worktree cleanup or Git-remote verification flows. No publisher-hosted model service is proposed for the Store edition. If a future release adds a network feature, this policy and the Store privacy information must be updated to describe it.

A suggestion is for review. It does not establish that a file is redundant and does not authorize cleanup.

Local records.

The planned app stores preferences such as appearance, motion, onboarding and menu-bar choices locally. Scan results may contain file metadata. Recovery receipts contain the original and Trash locations, file identities and operation status needed to evaluate a restore.

Removing a saved folder from Room removes its saved bookmark; it does not change another app’s data or revoke a macOS permission outside Room. Local records may remain until they are cleared through the supported app controls or removed from the app’s local container. Deleting the application alone is not a promise that every macOS-managed record has been erased.

No publisher analytics, advertising or tracking is proposed. The final Store privacy declarations will be checked against the actual release build and its reachable services, rather than inferred from an earlier direct-distribution version.

Support messages.

If you choose to contact support by email, the developer receives the information you send, such as your email address, message and any attachments. It is used to respond to the request and investigate the reported issue.

Please omit sensitive information and remove private paths, filenames and account details from screenshots. Support email may be retained as needed to resolve the request and keep a support history, or where a legal obligation requires it. You can ask about your support correspondence through the contact route below.

Changes to this policy.

This policy may change as the Store edition is finalized or the website changes. The updated date identifies the current version. Material changes to data use must also be reflected in the app and its Store privacy information where required.

Contact.

The developer is Konstantin Merenkov. For privacy questions or requests about support correspondence, contact the developerthe public contact route will be published before Room launches.

You can also find practical information on the support page.
